tp-top.label: Measure with the largest advantage in the best seasons
tp-top.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
tp-top.filters: Relative to league, best minus other seasons
tp-top.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (14) THEN (d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (14) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (14) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year

validation.method: plausibility range -5–5 for runs per over
